SESSION NARRATIVE: SK HYNIX SURGED AS MUCH AS 9.26% INTRADAY (HIGH ₩2,006,000 FROM PREV CLOSE ₩1,836,000) BEFORE SELLERS AGGRESSIVELY CAPPED THE ADVANCE NEAR ₩2,006,000, PULLING THE STOCK BACK TO CLOSE AT ₩1,871,000 (+1.91%). CRITICAL POST-KRX-CLOSE DEVELOPMENT: SK HYNIX RELEASED PRELIMINARY Q2 2026 FINANCIAL RESULTS AFTER THE KRX SESSION CLOSED (AFTER 15:30 KST / 06:30 UTC). THE PRELIMINARY RESULTS SHOW RECORD Q2 REVENUE AND PROFIT FUELED BY AI MEMORY DEMAND AND STRONG DRAM/NAND GROWTH, WITH A SIGNIFICANT POSITIVE EPS SURPRISE VS. CONSENSUS ESTIMATES. THE FULL Q2 EARNINGS CONFERENCE CALL IS SCHEDULED JULY 29 (9:00 AM KST). FRAMEWORK DECISION: BUY (GATE CLEARED). CONVICTION: MEDIUM (GATE CLEARED + RECORD Q2 EARNINGS; FULL CONVICTION AFTER JULY 29 HBM4 GUIDANCE). STOP: FRAMEWORK HARD STOP HOLDS AT ₩1,867,213 ON A CLOSING BASIS — IF PRICE RE-CLOSES BELOW THE GATE, THE STOP RE-ACTIVATES.

analysis:
## Technical analysis

### Session overview — framework gate cleared; record earnings after close
SK Hynix (000660.KS) registered a pivotal session on 2026-07-22: the KRX closed at ₩1,871,000, up ₩35,000 (+1.91%) from the July 21 close of ₩1,836,000. The session high of ₩2,006,000 represented a +9.26% intraday surge that pierced both the ₩2,000,000 psychological level and the ₩1,867,213 framework gate before sellers drove the stock down to close at ₩1,871,000 — only ₩3,787 above the gate. After the KRX close, SK Hynix released Q2 2026 preliminary earnings showing record profits and significant EPS beats.

**Key session data:**
- Previous close (July 21): ₩1,836,000
- Session open/low: ₩1,848,000
- Session high: ₩2,006,000 (+9.26% intraday — first above ₩2M since mid-June 2026)
- Session close: ₩1,871,000 (+1.91%)
- Intraday reversal from high: -₩135,000 / -6.7% (high to close)
- Framework gate: ₩1,867,213 — CLEARED (close ₩1,871,000 > gate by ₩3,787)

### Framework gate — CLEARED, re-entry triggered

| Gate condition | Threshold | July 21 close | July 22 close | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| KRX daily close | ₩1,867,213 | ₩1,836,000 ✗ | ₩1,871,000 ✓ | FIRST CLEARANCE SINCE JULY 17 |

The framework rule is categorical: 're-entry only on a confirmed KRX daily close above ₩1,867,213.' That condition is met today. The gate clearance is narrow (₩3,787) but technically valid. Per the framework, initiate re-entry. Stop: re-activates immediately on any subsequent daily close below ₩1,867,213 — the framework is mechanical on this point.

### The intraday 9% surge and reversal — read-through for overhead supply
The intraday pattern today is technically informative. The stock opened at ₩1,848,000 and surged to ₩2,006,000 — an ₩158,000 / +8.6% intraday move driven by:
1. P&T7 capex announcement (₩7.0931T) before the KRX open
2. Broad chip sector momentum from July 21
3. Pre-earnings positioning (Q2 full call July 29)

Then sellers crushed the advance from ₩2,006,000 to ₩1,871,000 at close — a -₩135,000 / -6.7% reversal in the same session. This price action documents three things:
- **Buyers**: Aggressive and present; drove a 9%+ move in a single session
- **Overhead supply**: Heavy above ₩1,900,000-₩2,006,000; sellers are real at the ₩2M level
- **Net result**: The two forces equalized at ₩1,871,000 — just above the framework gate

The gate clearance by a margin of ₩3,787 is concerning in that it could easily reverse on a modest session. The close is essentially AT the gate, not comfortably above it.

### Q2 2026 preliminary earnings — fundamental thesis validated
After the KRX close today, SK Hynix released Q2 2026 preliminary financial results. Key data:
- Q2 revenue and operating profit set new records
- EPS beat vs. consensus estimates was significant (consistent with DRAM ASP data showing +58-63% QoQ vs. KIS estimate of +28.9%)
- Revenue beat vs. consensus: positive

For context, Q1 2026 produced ₩52.5763T revenue and ₩37.6103T operating profit (72% margin). If DRAM prices rose 58-63% QoQ in Q2 (as reported by industry data), and assuming stable unit volumes, Q2 revenue could plausibly reach ₩70-90T+. The full breakdown (DRAM ASP realization, HBM volume pricing, NAND margin) will be disclosed at the July 29 conference call.

**Key Q2 earnings implication for the framework**: The July 13 -15.4% crash was driven by a KIS analyst reducing the Q2 OP estimate to ₩60.4T (8% below consensus ₩65T). If the actual Q2 OP substantially exceeds even the ₩65T consensus (which the DRAM price data and EPS beat suggest), the July 13 crash was a fundamental overreaction. The framework exit on July 17 (₩1,842,000) protected capital during the bleed to ₩1,732,000 (July 21), but the earnings vindication now creates re-entry urgency.

### Trend read — trend inflection from bear to recovery
The short-term trend picture before today (July 17-21) was clearly bearish: four sessions of lower closes from ₩1,842,000 (July 17) to ₩1,836,000 (July 20) to ₩1,764,000 (July 21 regular close) to the ₩1,732,000 intraday capitulation. Today's close at ₩1,871,000 breaks the descending pattern and clears the framework gate. The new ascending structure:
- July 20 close: ₩1,764,000
- July 21 close: ₩1,836,000 (+₩72,000)
- July 22 close: ₩1,871,000 (+₩35,000)

Three ascending closes after the ₩1,732,000 intraday low: the trend has inflected from bearish to recovering.

### Volume — intraday dynamics consistent with re-entry
The ₩158,000 intraday move (open to high) on heavy volume suggests institutional buyers are active in the ₩1,848,000-₩1,871,000 zone. The ₩135,000 reversal from ₩2,006,000 to ₩1,871,000 shows sellers using the ₩2,000,000 psychological level as an exit zone. Net result: the session absorbed both aggressive buying and aggressive selling, settling just above the framework gate. Volume was elevated (consistent with a 9% intraday move), indicating institutional participants on both sides.

### SKHY ADS — overnight re-rating signal
The US-listed SKHY ADS market will price in the Q2 preliminary earnings beat overnight (July 22-23 US trading). On July 21, SKHY surged 14% on pre-earnings optimism. With the actual preliminary beat now confirmed, SKHY ADS may gap further higher overnight — the US-listed ADS has been the institutional expression vehicle for the earnings thesis (40.2% premium to KRX parity on July 21). Tomorrow's KRX session direction will be partly guided by where SKHY ADS closes in US after-hours trading tonight.

### Strongest support: ₩1,867,213 — framework gate
This is both the strongest support AND the framework stop trigger. The framework is binary: close above = position active; close below = position revoked. Today's gate clearance by ₩3,787 is valid but tight. The ₩1,867,213 gate becomes the primary stop and support level simultaneously. Any close below this level triggers immediate position exit per the framework rules.

### Strongest resistance: ₩2,006,000 session high → ₩2,000,000 psychological
The ₩135,000 reversal from ₩2,006,000 to ₩1,871,000 today is the single most important technical event for the near-term resistance picture. Sellers were willing to sell ₩135,000 below their peak entry — that means they perceive significant value destruction above ₩2,000,000, OR they are framework-aware stop sellers targeting the ₩1,867,213 gate close. A sustained close above ₩2,000,000 after the July 29 full earnings call and positive HBM4 guidance would represent the next stage of the recovery.

### Key catalyst: Kimi K3 (July 27) vs. July 29 full earnings call
The two-day gap between Kimi K3 (July 27) and the full earnings call (July 29) is the most dangerous period for the framework re-entry. If Kimi K3 strong → HBM demand narrative weakens → sellers push SK Hynix below ₩1,867,213 on July 27 or July 28 → framework stop re-activates before the earnings call can provide a countervailing catalyst. Position sizing should be sized to account for this binary: re-enter per framework rules at medium size, not maximum allocation, until Kimi K3 resolves.

### What invalidates the bull recovery read
A KRX daily close below ₩1,867,213 re-activates the framework stop immediately — that's the mechanical invalidation trigger. Below that, a close below ₩1,800,000 signals the capitulation pattern has resumed.
